title: Transport of derived open units along a scheme isomorphism
statement: Let X be a scheme with chosen derived categories for module sheaves on X and all localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. Let A be a commutative ring, a:Spec(A)\simeq X a scheme isomorphism, and U an open of X. There exist chosen derived categories in the same morphism universe on Spec(A) and all its localized open sites, an equivalence F:D(O_Spec(A))\simeq D(O_X), right adjoints R_S,R_X to exact derived restriction to a^{-1}U and U, and adjunctions. The functor of F is identified, after precomposition with localization, with termwise restriction along a^{-1} followed by localization. F and its inverse preserve quasi-coherent homology; F preserves perfection [def-pc-perfect-complex]. For every Q, vanishing of its homology stalks on a^{-1}U implies vanishing of the homology stalks of F(Q) on U. The functor of F has a coherent structure commuting with integer shifts. For all K the adjunction unit on X is invertible if and only if the unit on Spec(A) at F^{-1}(K) is invertible. This is a transport statement for arbitrary objects, with no Koszul or orthogonality-detection conclusion.

proof.text: Use lem-pc-scheme-iso-derived-localizations to supply the spectrum and all localized open-site localizations in the requested universe. Construct the module pushforward equivalence of a from the composition and identity comparisons and localize it by Equivalence.mapDerivedCategory. Its localization factorization is mapDerivedCategoryFactors. Identify forward pushforward with restriction along a.inv using leftAdjointUniq; map this natural isomorphism degreewise and whisker by Q to obtain the required explicit restriction factorization.

Apply lem-pc-scheme-iso-derived-open-adjunction to the constructed derived equivalence and its pushforward localization comparison. This supplies both right adjoints, both adjunctions, and the pointwise unit-invertibility equivalence. The proof uses exact open restriction and K-injective resolutions, with no tensor pullback or K-flat left-derived construction.

Apply scheme_iso_derived_inverse_preserves_qcoh to a and to a.symm with the two explicit localization comparisons. Apply scheme_iso_derived_inverse_preserves_perfect to a.symm and the symmetric derived equivalence. For support, use mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso, the pushforward/restriction comparison, and restrictStalkNatIso a.inv to identify each target homology stalk with the source stalk at a.inv x. Transfer Subsingleton using the injectivity of the stalk isomorphism. The mapDerivedCategory CommShift instance supplies shift coherence.
